title: What the Wood Did Not Say

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The wood keeps the word it was told and the word it was not; the corner keeps its grey after the broom has gone the other way. A day nobody numbers is a day kept all the same.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Low Kiln yard, told over the kindling in Silt

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and thirty-eight to four hundred and forty days, six months and two hundred and fifty-eight to two hundred and sixty days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 437 exact at the opening on answer 450, closing at 440 exact on answer 456. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting. Silt 14, 15 and 16 are three ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes of at least eight hundred words, with no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner. Nothing from the second asking of Silt 12 or the Slate Row face of Silt 13 crosses under the roof on any of the three days as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and neither is told again on an unearned day. The house takes up its grammar as though nothing had turned. Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar at both ends of every day and the widow's mark stays untouched; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule. On Silt 15 Tarn withholds the sentence he told the wood on Silt 14 and says it again on Silt 16, so that the silence is found where put and not made a habit, a tenth stopping, a payment, a hearing or a rule, the loan uncalled in a term already ended. On Silt 16 the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw lie a hair less distinct along one stretch where no broom has gone, and the air off the river is softer at one edge where the low note runs nearer under its skin; he finds both where put, calls them weather and does not look twice or make a fourth covering, a sign or a payment. Silt 20 (Day 444), the month's second reading and the year's fifth, stands four mornings beyond the close as a date and is not brought.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Fourteenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{438}{Silt 14, Y.H. 814, Fourthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 450 and the count exact at 437, six months and two hundred and fifty-seven days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, four readings of the year behind one unsigned figure up the clay road in Berr Clay's locked box behind the twelve of Y.H. 813, four being four and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space; the second asking of Silt 12 and the Slate Row face of Silt 13 stand each on its own place with a finger between and are not told again on a morning that earned only its fourteenth. Then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning work of an ordinary Fourthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat with its left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw, twice-mended pot with the hairline showing, unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch, uncalled tile debt). Ilva offstage with her count still in wood and her fear unpaid; Hessa's slate unread up the road, Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket, the soft-cuffed clerk reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting. No market, Cross, bell, reading, runner or collector, and nothing from the fourth reading crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone past leather into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the keeping at the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding and not a placing, the thread stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back as at the end of a written line, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; the infant's three wants — crust lifted, thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle — quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither buying the other, the quarrel the work (T060/T086/T097, T004 held). Sella's whole grammar holds ahead of the basket in every order — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, small intake/hold/letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger along the shelf's top so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand shut half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline between older brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a Fourthday morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). At the kindling Tarn's six stand where the house can check and the seventh at the lip, small knife at the edge of its sill, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, and in the tone of a man stating the weather he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* — found where put and not made a habit, a tenth stopping, a payment or a rule (T036/T076/T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra's meal-fine grey slate dust ground small past the bent little finger and white in a fist-crease, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, wheel and pot spoken to before any person, full note known three turns ahead and withheld from any High Kiln master, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence with one bite holding and one taking and no Grathic word covering both, coming out without a second holding of Ash 26; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn against the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps 438 exact, six months and 258 days, and files answer 451 on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Fourteenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Silt 14 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 452 filed and the count at 438 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-eight days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar: a pail set down on the flat stone by the well with its flat knock, a rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, barley wall to wall without a number, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure. Ilva offstage with her strip in wood and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's single slate unread up the road, Berr's box locked up the road, the clerk still reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting, a witness or a tenth hand. The second asking of Silt 12 and the Slate Row face of Silt 13 are not repeated on a day that earned only its fourteenth. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, and takes each apart by fist, eye, mouth and the half-beat in the gap, giving the gap no intention, for an intention wants a payer where none stands (T061/T082). He goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back — no name, no body, no figure, no accident, no payer; the trough keeps the gone pan's round print on a place of its own, and the two unswept lines at the Vail corner keep a finger between the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, unswept and called weather, not looked at twice (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092 held). Costs come as directions and go away as weather: a fist up out of a shut hand toward the water or the light, looked at, shut, back into a sleeve, arriving nowhere; a woman sent to ask a pot's cost gets a note and not a price; the arithmetic read over covered grain at home does not know what it cost and the ink-neat space between figure and price carries no signature (T077). No slate opened within reach of the basket, no figure entered, no money passed. Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace, says nothing to the basket of what the day was; the whole grammar returns at both ends of the day — fire before basket, coals told the thaw, charcoal unread under her finger, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar, twice-mended pot thumb-first with hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched, fold righted without a look at his face and no second fold, keeping found where put (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). The file in the small hours: towel out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done; he goes over the day by the place of each thing with every gap a gap and does not add them, for a surgeon who adds findings before the last is in has already made up his answer. Six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing house's flat knock outside on its own place; the heard bell beside the told bell with both gaps in their own squares and three counts in three places staying three; nine record-first hands with nine stoppings and no tenth; seven openings in seven months not a rule. The offered figure and its return, the second asking of Silt 12, the Slate Row face of Silt 13, the reported second slate of Silt 6, the neighbour's near-reaching at the shelf, the hair-thin thaw of Silt 7, the clerk's entered figure brought up the yard as a report and never a sighting, the fifth shaping of the well-saying, the three likenesses of Slate Row, the burned slate at five and the four ownerless directions stand each on its own place with a finger between every pair — none a reader, a witness, a tenth hand, a custom, a payment or a payer, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082, T078, T080/T090/T102, T097, T065/T095, T101 held). Four readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure up the clay road — four being four and not one account, the first not made a thirteenth by the three that followed, the second no signature, the third no doctrine, the fourth no payer, the twelve of Y.H. 813 not laid across the four to make a row come out even, the figure read still not the figure paid — and none is made to answer any kept thing under this roof; the unsent call to Nina stands where it was put and is not paid again (T015/T041/T047, T020). **Answer 452** filed; count holds at **438 exact**, six months and 258 days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number. Silt 20 (Day 444) stands four mornings off as a date and is not brought.

scenes.title: The Fifteenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{439}{Silt 15, Y.H. 814, Fifthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 452 and the count exact at 438, six months and two hundred and fifty-eight days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning of an ordinary Fifthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn offstage at the kindling and flagstones with his keepings found where put, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip still in her sleeve and her fear unpaid. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner, and nothing from Silt 14 crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097); the surgeon reads the house by what it will not say rather than by what it will not survive, and a warm room insisting a body is warm while the fingers go the colour of old rope is read past tense and untagged, paying nothing (T004 held). The morning's honest work is given its texture — dressed grain lifted for damp, turned piece by piece with a progressively lighter touch and laid back under wool with no figure or handful, the pot board and twice-mended pot with the hairline showing, the half-beat at the setting — and Sella's fire-before-basket grammar holds ahead of the basket in every order; the widow's mark is untouched because a Fifthday morning is not an opening and seven openings are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn's six stand in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the knife at the sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, *Six counted. The next I don't count* found where put and not made a habit; the ear-sentence stays stopped at the word that would call the loan, Seed 16 breath unspent, valuable ear exposure and not safety, fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure, loan uncalled in a term already ended (T036/T076/T006). The boy does not anticipate that the word which came to the wood on the fourteenth will not come this afternoon; he files no cause across the morning's quiet. Jorra's bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one bite holding one taking, no Grathic word for both, one holding of Ash 26 gathered once and not made again; men unnamed go low into the back room before first grey and get no name from him; full note known and withheld, *he's not Vail* sealed, promise neither given nor withdrawn against the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps **439 exact**, six months and 259 days, and files **answer 453** on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air and not a doctrine (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Fifteenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Silt 15 afternoon at the kindling and flagstones, going of the light, small hours at the close, with answer 454 filed and the count at 439 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-nine days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan (carried to the kindling), Sella Vail, **Tarn** on stage at the kindling; Jorra Vail offstage at the wheel-shed with his keeping found where put; Garl Vail in objects. Day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: **the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T036/T076/T006 with T061/T082).** In the afternoon the six still stand in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill, Tarn's hand going over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking — and he says no word to the wood. The sentence he told the kindling on Silt 14 is withheld, so that a withholding is a change and not a drift; he will say it again on Silt 16 so that the silence is found where put and not made a habit, for a second silence would be a custom and a third a way and both want a payer where none stands. The boy takes the absence apart by the place of what was there and what was not — six in the mark, seven at the lip, the knife set back, the hand away, the space where the sentence would have stood and is a space — and files it on a place of its own beside the older stopped sentence and Garl's unforged collector sentence: a hand withdrawn from a field before the dressing goes on, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, expressly **not a tenth stopping, not a payment, not a hearing, not a rule, not a custom**, no payer named and no slate entered, and not laid across the second asking of Silt 12, the Slate Row face of Silt 13, the reported second slate, the clerk's entered figure, Jorra's ungiven promise or the four readings behind one unsigned figure, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The loan stays uncalled in a term already ended, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his valuable ear exposure and not safety; he takes the broom only after it has been given its instruction, says *Yes, house* to the fire and does not turn his head toward the landing. Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace and says nothing to the basket of what the kindling withheld; under the roof the whole grammar comes back as though nothing had turned — fire before basket, coals told the thaw, charcoal unread under her finger, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar, twice-mended pot thumb-first with hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched, fold righted without a look at his face and no second fold, keeping found where put (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). Costs go away as weather (T077); the six hearings stay six with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside (T061/T082); the offered figure, second asking, Slate Row face, reported second slate, near-reaching and two market sightings stay on their separate places and none is made to answer the withheld word (T080/T090/T102, T050/T051). **Answer 454** filed; count holds at **439 exact**, six months and 259 days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number.

scenes.title: The Sixteenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{440}{Silt 16, Y.H. 814, Sixthday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 454 and the count exact at 439, six months and two hundred and fifty-nine days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning of an ordinary Sixthday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip in wood and her fear unpaid. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner, and nothing from Silt 15's withheld sentence crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the withholding is not repeated on a day that earned only its sixteenth. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order — horn-hard crust with its hair-lifted corner two inches off, keeping found where put in the empty place, thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097). The surgeon's register reads the body by the order of its small failures and buys nothing. Sella's grammar holds at the morning: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, charcoal unread under her finger, twice-mended pot thumb-first with hairline showing, dressed grain covered under wool and unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a Sixthday morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn's six stand in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the small knife at the sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, and in the tone of a man stating the weather he **says the sentence again** — *Six counted. The next I don't count* — so that the silence of the fifteenth is found where put and not made a habit, a tenth stopping, a payment, a hearing or a rule; the ear-sentence stays stopped at the word that would call the loan in a term already ended, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra's dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, three or more unnamed men go low into the back room before first grey and get no name from him, the bent finger leads at the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence with one bite holding and one taking and no second holding of Ash 26, full note known three turns ahead and withheld from any High Kiln master, *he's not Vail* sealed, the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn while the burned slate stands at five; the two quiet men stay unjoined (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps **440 exact**, six months and 260 days, and files **answer 455** on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air and not a doctrine (T071/T072).

scenes.title: What the Sixteenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Silt 16 afternoon at the Vail corner and the finger's-width door, going of the light, small hours closing the chapter, with answer 456 filed and the count at 440 exact, six months and two hundred and sixty days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her count in wood and her fear unpaid. Day already dated in Scene 5. Dramatic purpose: **the second advance, advanced and NOT paid (T083/T085/T092 with T009/T013/T092).** In the afternoon, at the Vail corner, the clean dark line keeps its finer grey called the thaw a hair less distinct along one unswept stretch where no broom has gone in two years, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash coming up off it; through the finger's-width door the air off the river is less cold at one edge where the low note of water over water runs nearer under the winter skin, the tang thinner there. He finds both where put, does not look twice, calls them weather — not a sign, not a fourth covering, not a fourth likeness, not a sixth shaping, not a payment, with no hand or payer under either grey and not made again. Sella tells the fire it is the thaw and does not tell the basket. The two greys at the corner keep a finger between the called-gone beside the left-in-place; a thing left in place is not a thing forgiven. The old-life register supplies the shape of frost leaving a ward window in two lines that met at a corner and a nurse calling it the weather and going on with her count, read by where the lines stopped and not by the name given them — past tense, untagged, paying nothing, with no present-tense break spent and no \memory{} tag used (T004 held). Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace, says nothing to the basket of the greys or of what the day was; the whole grammar comes back as though nothing had turned, widow's mark untouched, fold righted without a look at his face and no second fold, keeping found where put (T058/T079, T060/T086/T097). Small hours: the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done, rough from the wash and smelling of tallow and low smoke. He goes over the day by the place of each thing with every gap a gap and does not add them. Six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing's knock outside; heard bell beside told with both gaps in squares and three counts in three places staying three; nine record-first hands with nine stoppings and no tenth; seven openings in seven months and not a rule. The withheld word of Silt 15 stands on its own place beside the older stopped sentence, not a tenth stopping; the second asking, the Slate Row face, the reported second slate, the neighbour's near-reaching, the hair-thin thaw of Silt 7, this sixteenth day's hair-thin thaw, the clerk's entered figure, the fifth shaping, the three likenesses and the two market sightings on separate trays stand each on its own place with a finger between every pair (T061/T082/T078, T080/T090/T102, T050/T051). Four readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure — four being four and not one account, the first not a thirteenth, the second no signature, the third no doctrine, the fourth no payer, the twelve of Y.H. 813 not laid across the four, the figure read still not the figure paid — and none is made to answer any kept thing under this roof; Silt 20 (Day 444), the month's second reading and the year's fifth, stands four mornings off as a date and is not brought (T015/T041/T047). The unsent call to Nina stays where it was put and is not paid again (T020). **Answer 456** filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment; six honest answers **451–456** stand there, two to each of the three days, not one a doctrine, and 456 answers stand there in all. Count **440 exact**, six months and 260 days told by nobody; the carried fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, the man and the fire standing side by side without becoming one, for a number counted is a number with air around it and air buys no warmth (T088). Through the finger's-width door the river keeps its low note of water over water under the winter skin, softer at one edge, the note coming from under the covering and ending on its own finishing. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward it — the inch not a reach, not a wanting made into a claim, only the body's small assent to a sound — takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole on the note's finishing, lets it go and comes straight down and lays itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. There is no next hand in the room. He does not wipe the thread and does not lift the crust. Under the boards the four low pulls keep their silence where the fifth should have stood and nobody supplies the pull. Forward into a seventeenth day not lived and not brought.
